name: @altruist/net
description: Altruist networking for game clients: MessagePack wire format and envelopes (twin of Altruist.Client MessageEnvelopeShape / ClientPacketDispatcher), the AltruistSocket WebSocket transport (tickets, reconnect, heartbeat, fleet redirects), connection diagnostics (ping, clock sync, network conditioner), rate-limit twins, and schema-driven snapshot decoders (twin of SnapshotSchemaSet). No dependencies.
